advanced-filter-description: Levenzoittud puhtastim laskeb kirjutada tekstirivin, kudambas oma nätšed operatorad: == != <= >= && || ( ) Probel kävutadas operatoroiden erigoitandaks. Voit puhtastada kaik kävutajan märitud pöudod, kirjutades niiden nimed da znamoičendad. Ozutesikš: Field1 == Value1. Homaičuz: ku pöudoiden nimiš libo znamoičendoiš oma probelad, pane ne üksižihe velgznamoihe. Ozutesikš: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Miše hüljätä üksittäižed eriližed simvolad (' \/), kävuta \. Ozutesikš: Field1 == I\'m. Voit mugažo ühtenzoita äi ehtoid. Ozutesikš: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Tavaližešti kaik operatorad tul'kitas huralpäi oigedale. Voit vajehtada järgendusen suluiden abul. Ozutesikš: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Voit mugažo eciä tekstpöudoiš regexan abul: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-markdown: Namatedza mutevhe wa mishumo ya markdown (nzila ine zwishumiswa zwa markdown-kanban zwo nga Obsidian Kanban zwi shumisaho): thoho dza "## Dzina ḽa mutevhe", na zwithu zwa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" fhasi. Thoho dzi vha mitevhe nahone zwithu zwi vha makhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Liida Leo rakenuz (.leo fail). Ülimäižed osad muutudas lugetižiks, nende lapsosad muutudas kartiks, i osan tekst om kartan kirjutuz. Süvembäd osad muutudas kodvindlugetižiks. Merkitud osad tulodas vaumižiks.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Pane todo.txt fail: üks' rad kaikuzehe strokkaha, kut todo.txt program da senke sopivad programad kirjutadas. Vaumižed radod ("x") mäntas «Vaumiž»-nimeližehe nimikirjaha, +project da @context tul'das lipukoikš, (A) tulob tärketusen lipukaks, da due: da t: tul'das lopetus- da augotuspäiviks.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ličta task export -komandan tulos: JSON-massiv vai üks’ tego jogahižel rivil. Vaumhed tegod mänoba Done-lugetišehe, project da priority tegesoiš znamadeks, annotations sel’genzoitusiks, da depends tegoiden sidoksiks, kudambad telustadas tegemist.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ava .boardarchive-arhiv da ličta laudan board.jsonl, versionrivin ke vai ilman sidä. Laudan näguman joukoihe jagamižen ominaižuz’ tegesoi lugetišiks, toižed valičendan ominaižuded znamadeks, tekstan da märkitsemisruuduiden blokad kirjutuseks da kodvindlugetišeks, da sel’genzoitused kaicetas. Kuvid da ličtusid ei toda.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. States become lists, projects become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their identifier, parent, assignees, labels, dates, links and comments; priority, estimate, cycle and module become custom fields. Plane's export has no descriptions or attachments, so they are not imported.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ičeze Trello-laudal mäne 'Menu', siš 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', da kopirui sadud tekst.
import-board-instruction-csv: Pane CSV (katkimel erigoittud znamoičendad) libo TSV (Tab-znamal erigoittud znamoičendad).
import-board-instruction-jira: Ličta JSON Jira Cloud REST API issue search-ospäi (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), vai ühtejitte { "issues": [...] } -objekt. Jiran statusad tegesoiš listoiks i issue-t kartoiks. Voit ližata mugažo "automationRules"-massivan praviloiden sizäletondaks.

r-wrike-workflow-note: A Wrike workflow is a list of statuses, each in the Active, Completed, Deferred or Cancelled group. Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. Wrike's own automation rules cannot be exported from Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Ecindas voib kävutada operatoroid, miše röunatada ecindad. Operatoran nimi da znamoičend kirjutadas erigoittud ":"-znamal. Ozutesikš operator `lugetiž:Blocked` ecib vaiše kartoid lugetišespäi nimenke *Blocked*. globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kartad, miččil om znam, miččen muju om *<color>* libo nimi om *<name>*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kartad, miččed oma tehtud *<n>* päiväd tagaze libo vähemba
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kartad, miččed oma vajehtadud *<n>* päiväd tagaze libo vähemba
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - kaik arhivaha sirttud kartad da kaik toižed kartad
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - *<field>* om üks neciš: `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` libo `__predicate_member__`. Pane `-` *<field>* edele, miše ecta kartoid, miččil ei ole necen pöudon znamoičendad (näute: `om:-märaig` ecib kartoid ilma märaigata).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - *<sort-name>* om üks neciš: `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` libo `__predicate_modified__`. Vastkarižen järgendusen täht pane `-` nimen edele.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - *<n>* om kogonaine lugu, mi om suremb 0: kartoiden lugumär joga lehtpolel.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ühtejiččed operatorad ühtenzoitadas *LIBO*-kodvindanke. Näguba kartad, miččil om hot' üks neciš kodvindiš.
`__operator_list__:Joudai __operator_list__:Seižutadud` ozutab kartoid lugetišiš *Joudai* libo *Seižutadud*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Erazvuiččed operatorad ühtenzoitadas *DA*-kodvindanke. Näguba vaiše kartad, miččil oma kaik neced kodvindad. `__operator_list__:Joudai __operator_label__:rusked` ozutab vaiše kartoid lugetišes *Joudai* *rusked*-znamanke.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Päividen lugun voi märita pozitivine libo negativine kogonaine lugu, libo kävutada `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` libo `__predicate_year__` nügüdläižen aigkeskustan täht.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Tekstan ecind ei erištele surid da penid kirjamid.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Sanumata ecind om ilma arhivaha sirttud kartoid.

database-migration-description: Migrirui tekst-andmused (kaik paiči ličtusid i avataroid, kudambad jädas failsistemale) MongoDB-n i FerretDB v1-n (SQLite) keskes. Toine andmbaz pidab käta i olda saavutadav (alolaižed portad: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; vajehta WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL-ke). Konz se loptase, ozuta MONGO_URL toižehe andmbazha i käta WeKan uzin (Snap-al: snap set wekan database=ferretdb vai =mongodb).
database-migration-confirm: Kopirui kaik tekst-kollekcijad __db__-ha? Failsisteman ličtused i avatarad ei koskkoi. Tähtandmbaz pidab käta.
sandstorm-migration-description: Konz WeKan käib Sandstorm-grainan südäimes, sen vanh MongoDB 3 -andmbaz migriruidas FerretDB v1:he (SQLite) ezmäižel kätandal, i ličtused i avatarad sirdädas andmbazaspäi grainan files/attachments i files/avatars -kanzoihe. Nece ozutab, udannus-ik nece migracii, i mihe pal'l' diskan tilad vanhad raw MongoDB -andmbazan failad völ otas grainan südäimes, i andab hävitada nenäd raw-failad tilan vabastamha.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Jäl'ges udannuz migracijan andmused eläbad FerretDB-s i failsistemal, muga vanhad raw MongoDB 3 -andmbazan failad voidas hävitada grainan diskan tilan vabastamha. Necidä ei sa pörutada.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Hävita raw MongoDB 3 -andmbazan failad diskan tilan vabastamha? Andmused oma jo migriruidud FerretDB-ha i failsistemale. Necidä ei sa pörutada.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Raw MongoDB andmbazan failad hävitadud, vabastadud
features-desc: WeKan anttab valičendaližed ominazused. Ominazuz, kudamb om valičemata, om peittud kaikil päi kävutajil. Sen tedod kaičetas da oiktused ei toižetase.
feature-views-table-desc: Laud kut kartiden tablic, kudamban voib järjestada.
feature-views-overview-desc: Statistik, hulgad andtud rado tegijan mödhe, radon plan, kontrollan laud da sur' laud.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Produktan jäl'ghe jätnuded radod, lühüd radon aigad, aigan raport da radon teravuz.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Jäl'ghe jätnud rado, lopetadud rado, kogotud vool, radon aig da aig pakičendaspäi lopetandhasai, lopetadud radon määr, radon vartomizen aig, varad, Monte Carlo da toižed voolan mitad.
feature-views-map-desc: Kartad kut märgid üleladatud kuvaha päle.
feature-approval-required: Jätä WeKan-an uzindamižiden ližatud ominazused kävutamata, kuni administrator paneb nece kävutusele
feature-preview-admins: Administratorad nägeba kävutamata ominazusi, miše ezmäi kockta neid
feature-pilot-users: Kockimizen kävutajad, kudambad nägeba kävutamata ominazusi mugažo
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Kaičedud. Neciš kävutajiden nimiš ei löütnu:
card-field-visibility-desc: The fields of Board Settings / Card that boards can show. An unticked field is hidden from every card, minicard and Board Settings / Card of every board. No card data or board setting changes, and ticking it again shows each board as it was set. The order of the fields is each board's own.
cards-loading-description: WeKan ladib laudan kartad avtomatižešti: sur laud (suruzülimärad suremb) ladib vaiše nügüd' nägujad kartad (loppmatoi skrolind) da elävan lugun, muga se radab piged, kävutab vähemba muštad da sirdab vähemba andmusid verkon mödhe; penembad laudad ladiba kaik kartad, miše kävutand oliži kaikuten kebn da kaik funkcijad oližiba kävutandaha. Ei pidagoi sädada midä-se. Operatorad voiba völ pakita režiman CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) da CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD -ümbrišton vajehtujiden abul.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Laškan kartoiden ladind om eksperimentaline: kartoiden lugijad i WIP-rajad oma tarkad, no Kalendar/Tablic/Gantt-nägud i äi valičuz ozutaba vaiše nenäd kartad, kudambad om jo ladidud. Lada avoinad laudad uzin necen vajehtandan jäl'ghe.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Konz om päl, kaik linkad (kut markdown-linkad [label](url) muga mugažo raw HTML <a href> -tegud) ozutadas aina tühjan, painmatoman tekstan jogahižes rikkas tekst-pöudos (laudan i kartan pälkirjutesed, kuvadused, komentariid, kontroll-listad i muut). Nece hulub petliženvoiččid painmižoid linkoid. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud, muga linkad jädas painmoihe.
always-show-code-as-text: Ozuta aina kaik kod tühjan tekstan
always-show-code-as-text-description: Konz om päl, rikaz tekst nikonz ei ozutada kut markdown vai HTML: kaik purte ozutadas aina tühjan tekstan jogahižes rikkas tekst-pöudos (laudan i kartan pälkirjutesed, kuvadused, komentariid, kontroll-listad i muut). Nece avaidab peittud sisustod — HTML-komentariid (<!-- -->), markdown-linkoiden tähtsijad, JavaScript i mi tahouz toine kod — muga kaik kod om aina nägub, ei painmoi i ei käi. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud, muga markdown ozutadas normaližešti.
disable-all-import-description: Konz om päl, kaik sizäletond-ominazused sammutadas: laudan sizäletond WeKan JSON-aspäi, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea i Forgejo, mugažo laudan kloniruind. Sizäletond-menün valindad peittas i server hüljäb mi tahouz sizäletond-küzundan. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
disable-all-export-description: Konz om päl, kaik irdalevend-ominazused sammutadas: laudan vend irdale kut WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, vai NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo-ha, i ühten ličtusen irdalevend. Irdalevend-menün valindad peittas i server hüljäb mi tahouz irdalevend-küzundan. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
disable-import-avatars-description: Konz om päl, avataroid (kävutajiden profil'-kuvid) nikonz ei toda. Nece koskeb WeKan JSON -sizäletondan, Trello-sizäletondan i avataroiden sinhronizacijan irdaližiš tundenduz-andajiš sizälekirjutandal (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Nimed i toižed andmused todas edelläze; vaiše avatarad hüljätas. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
disable-export-avatars-description: Konz om päl, avataroid (kävutajiden profil'-kuvid) nikonz ei ottа laudan irdalevendha (WeKan JSON i CSV -irdalevend). Kävutajanimed i toižed andmused vedädas irdale edelläze; vaiše avatarad hüljätas. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
anonymize-import-users-description: Konz om päl, WeKan JSON -laudan sizäletond vajehtab jogahižen todud kävutajan kävutajanimen, täuden nimen i inicialad lugu-placeholderoiks (user1, user2, ...), hüljäb niiden avataran, i kirjutab uzin @username-maindad (i requested-by / assigned-by -pöudod) todud kartan i komentarian sisustos. Nimidä todešt kävutajan personad purtespäi ei kaita. Sana "user" mäneb sen mehen kelen mödhe, ken tob. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
anonymize-export-users-description: Konz om päl, laudan irdalevend vajehtab jogahižen vedetud kävutajan kävutajanimen, täuden nimen i inicialad lugu-placeholderoiks (user1, user2, ...), hüljäb niiden avataran, i kirjutab uzin @username-maindad (i requested-by / assigned-by -pöudod) kartan i komentarian sisustos. Vedetud fail ei kanda nimidä todešt kävutajan personad. Sana "user" mäneb sen mehen kelen mödhe, ken vedаb irdale. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Konz om päl, laudan irdalevend vajehtab jogahižen vedetud kävutajan kävutajanimen, täuden nimen i inicialad lugu-placeholderoiks (user1, user2, ...), hüljäb niiden avataran, i kirjutab uzin @username-maindad (i requested-by / assigned-by -pöudod) kartan i komentarian sisustos. Vedetud fail ei kanda nimidä todešt kävutajan personad. Sana "user" mäneb sen mehen kelen mödhe, ken vedаb irdale. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
disable-activities-description: Konz om päl, aktiviž-virran kirjutesid nikonz ei kaita i nikus ei ozutada (laudan bokan i kartan aktiviž-tab). Nimidä istorijad se polhe, ken midä tegi, ei kaita. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
disable-notifications-description: Konz om päl, WeKan nikonz ei oigenda kaceluz-tedotusid (appan südäimes, email vai toižed službad) mi tahouz aktivižudes. Aktivižused voidas kaita edelläze (ku ei ole mugažo sammutadud ülähän); vaiše tedotused hulubas. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
disable-watch-description: Konz om päl, kaceluz-ominazuz sammutadas — kävutajad ei voigoi kirjutadas laudoile, listoile vai kartoile tedotusiden sanmižeks, i mi tahouz kaceluz-tason vajehtandan probind hüljätas. Alolaižešti se om sammutadud.
backup-description: Tege varmkopii Ličtusiš, Avataroiš i/vai Andmusiš (kaik tekst-kollekcijad, kudambad ei ole ličtused vai avatarad). .zip virdab kohtha valitud kaicendha — ilma vremennoi failta — kut backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, kudambas om YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars i /data. Pil'v-kaicendad (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) kävutaba niiden kaicend-tabiš säd tud tundenduz-andmusid.
backup-scope-description: Kaik WeKan-sistem libo üks' organizacii. Organizacijan varmkopijas oma sen laudad da kaik niil, mugažo nende laudoiden tartutadud failad — no ei ole kävutajiden akkauntoid libo sisteman valičusid, sikš miše kaik organizacijad kävutaba neid ühteži. Organizacijan varmkopijan endištamine kirjutab vaiše laudoile, miččed oma necen organizacijan.
theme-override-all-tenants: Mavhonele a shumaho kha vhahiri vhoṱhe
continuous-backup-description: Sirdab kaik andmbazan, ličtusiden, avataroiden da žurnaliden vajehtused katalomha muutaman sekundan aigan, miše endištada olo mijä tahes aigale. Nece radab ühtes aigan märitud varmkopijan tegemizenke, kudamb tegeb täuded arhivad.
continuous-backup-target: Tähtkatalog (täuz' te, toižel diskal, verkon ühtežel kaicendal libo rclone-ličtundas)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (program, kudamban voit asetta, ku tahod)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Üks'ki andmbazan motor ei voi radata necel serveral
continuous-backup-key-file: Šifruindan avadimen fail (täuz' te, tähtkatalogan ulkopolel; 64 kuštoštkantališt märki libo peitsanad, kudambis om 16 märki libo enamb). Kaice kopii: ilman necidä avadint varmkopijad ei voi endištada.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: SQLite-andmbazan fail (tehtas varmkopijan redale; ei nikonz kirjutada sen failan päle, kudamb om kävutuses)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Pane udes tehtud SQLite-andmbaz paigale jälgmäižel udes kävutamisel (vanh andmbaz kaicetas)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Endišta valitud kopijoiden polv valitud aigale? Varmkopijan tegemine seižutamata seižutadas vähäks aigaks endištamižen aigan.
backup-restore-confirm: Pöruta valitud varmkopii? Ličtused/avatarad kirjutadas failsistemale i andmused andmbazha valitud režiman mödhe.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ei pakolline: te serveral olebha služb-akkauntan JSON-ključ-failha.
gcs-credentials-description: Ei pakolline: ličta služb-akkauntan JSON-ključ. Jäta tühjaks, miše kävutada ključ-fail vai alolaižed tundenduz-andmused.
gcs-permissions-note: Anda WeKanan služb-akkauntale lugend/kirjutuz-oigenduz bucketha: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → sinun bucket → Permissions → Grant access. "New principals"-pöudos ličta služb-akkauntan email — "client_email"-znamoituz sinun JSON-ključaspäi — sid' vali rol' "Storage Object Admin" i Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Jäta tühjaks, miše kaita nügüdläine znamoituz.
gcs-bucket-description: Cloud Storage -bucketan nimi, kuna kaita failoid.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: jäta tühjaks (kävutab regionan endpointan). S3-ühtenmüline: Endpoint URL sinun MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces -konsolespäi.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → sinun bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → sinun bucketan nimi (vai Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → sinun kävutai → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → vali use case 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Ozutadas kut 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Se-žo ekran kut Access key ID; 'Secret access key' ozutadas vaiše ühten kerdan, konz ključ luodas — kopirui se sid' (vai Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sinun akkaunt → nimi ülähän (mugažo Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sinun akkaunt → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sinun akkaunt → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sinun akkaunt → Data storage → Containers → sinun konteiner (vai + Container luadmha uden).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → projektan valdai ülähän → sinun projektan ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → sinun bucketan nimi (vai Create luadmha uden).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Te WeKan-serveral ladidud služb-akkauntan JSON-ključ-failha (luodud alahan). Kävuta necidä VAI ličta JSON pöudho alahan.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → sinun služb-akkaunt → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (ladib failan). Ličta sen sisust tänna, vai kaita fail i pane sen te ülähän.
gridfs-enabled-description: Kävuta MongoDB GridFS failoiden kaičusen täht
migration-stop-confirm: Tahtoid-ik sinä tozi seižutada kaik migracijad?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Miše ličtused i avatarad oližiba nägujad, sirdä ned CollectionFS-aspäi mi tahouz toižehe kaicendha.
s3-enabled-description: Kävuta AWS S3 libo MinIO failoiden kaičusen täht
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Kaikenpoližešti kodvib da kohendab laudan andmusid, mugažo lugetišiden jäl’gendust, kartoiden sijoid da ujundšoidoiden strukturad, miše niil ei oliži vigoid.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Heittäb tühjiden lugetišiden dublikatad ilman varuta. Heittäb vaiše lugetišed, kudambiš ei ole kartoid DA kudambil om toine ühtejiččen nimenke lugetiž, kudambas om kartoid.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Ecib da endištab kartad da lugetišed, kudambil ei ole swimlaneId libo listId. Tegeb 'Lost Cards' ujundšoidun, miše möst ozutada kaik kadonu azjad.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Endištab kaik arhivaha sirttud ujundšoidud, lugetišed da kartad. Kohendab avtomatižesti swimlaneId libo listId, ku niid ei ole, miše ozutada azjad.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Löudab da kohendab laudan strukturas lugetišid, miččid ei ole libo oma travitud.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Udištab laudan ühtnikoiden avataroiden URL-adresad oiktan kaičusen sisteman kävutamižen täht da kohendab radmatomad avataroiden tarkendused.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Udištab kaik necen laudan tartutadud failoiden URL-adresad oiktan kaičusen sisteman kävutamižen täht da kohendab radmatomad failoiden tarkendused.
migrations-admin-only: Vaiše laudan administratorad voiba tehta migracijad
migrations-description: Kodvi da kohenda necen laudan andmused, miše niil ei oliži vigoid. Kaikuččen migracijan voib tehta eriži.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Nece tegeb kaikenpoline migracii, miše kodvda da kohendada laudan andmusid, miše niil ei oliži vigoid. Nece voib otta vähän aigad. Jatkta?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Nece vajehtab ezmäi kaik ühthižed lugetišed eriližihe lugetišihe kaikuččen ujundšoidun täht, sid’ heittäb tühjad lugetišed, kudambil om toine ühtejiččen nimenke lugetiž kartoidenke. Heittas vaiše todesižešti tarbhatomad tühjad lugetišed. Jatkta?

scrum-import-preview-releases: Releases: __created__ new, __matched__ already on this board, __skipped__ not imported
scrum-import-preview-cards: Cards: __updated__ to update, __unchanged__ unchanged, __unmatched__ not matched
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Nothing to change: this board already has this planning.
scrum-import-into-board-done: The Scrum planning was imported and recorded in History.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: A card was not found on this board: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: A card matches more than one card on this board: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: A card belongs to another board and was left unchanged: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: A sprint or release matches more than one on this board: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: A sprint, release or event could not be imported: __reference__

sync-conflict-hint: Choose a value for each conflict. Sync retries after each choice. Nothing is sent to the source system.
sync-conflict-refresh: Run Sync again to review the current values.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Your assigned cards have been reviewed. No field conflicts remain. Full-list Sync was not run.
sync-conflict-detach: Keep duplicate as a local card
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Remove only this duplicate’s Sync mapping. Its content stays in WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive-hint: The source item is gone, but active subcards prevent archival. Keep this card locally by removing its Sync mapping. Subcards are not changed.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Keep the previous card unchanged and create a new Sync card in this list. Retries reuse the replacement.
sync-preview-saved: Based on saved settings. Sync now fetches and checks the source again.
sync-preview-unavailable: Save a Sync source before requesting a preview.
sync-preview-blocked: Resolve the conflicts below before reviewing the change plan.
sync-preview-scope: Counts refer to normalized source fields. Additional data may be omitted by the source parser.
sync-source-scope: Paths group field occurrences across source items. Unmapped objects are reported as a whole; their values are not shown.
sync-source-converted: Converted to text or another representation
sync-source-fallback: Alternate value not used by the parser
sync-source-truncated: The report is limited to 100 paths and shortened field names.
sync-source-omitted: Additional occurrences outside the displayed paths
sync-report-retention: Latest 20 runs. Reports are retained for 30 days.
sync-report-partial: Failed or unfinished runs may have changed some cards. These reports do not resume or undo a run.
sync-report-unfinished: In progress or interrupted; outcome not recorded
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Completed with omitted or converted fields
sync-report-unavailable: Run reports require full-list write access and an available server.
sync-recovery-description: Retained Sync reports from the last 30 days. Search by board or list ID. An unfinished outcome may still be running or interrupted. Refresh to check again; these reports cannot resume or undo changes.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Unable to read Sync diagnostics. Check administrator access and server availability.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Select a numeric field with a Jira field ID and estimate unit, as created by a mapped Jira import. Local changes are reviewed as conflicts. Missing source values are ignored; an explicit null clears the mapped value.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: GitLab-an jügu vai arvostadud aig kirjutadas lugupol'he, miččen valičed. Täna tehtud vajehtused tarkištadas konfliktadeks; jügunta azj heitäb sidotud lugun.
email-recovery-description: Üks’ jono kaikuččele saajale. Eci kävutajan ID:n mödhe. Kirjeižiden kontentad da saajan email-adresan polid ei ozuteta. Seizatamine pidäb nügüdläižid da tulevaid kirjeižid; jatkamine ladib oigeta jonos olijid kirjeižid nügüd’ udes. Heitamine heitäb kirjeižed, miččed oliba jonos küzundan aigassai. Ku oigendamine om radamas, ladi udes vähä aigad jäl’ghe. Kirjeižt, midä jo oigetas, ei sa pördutada tagaze, da epävarman oigendamižen voib tehta udes. Aina kestajad vigad da kirjeižed, miččiden ladimiden lugumär om täuz’, jäädas kacundan täht. Oigendamata kirjeižiden oigendamižen uz’ ladimine augotab uden ladimiden ciklan da kaičeb nügüdläižen seizatamižen.
email-recovery-empty: Jonos ei ole kirjeižid da ei ole saajid, miččiden oigendamine om seizatadud.
email-recovery-unavailable: Email-kirjeižiden jonod ei voi lugeda. Tarkišta administratoran oiktused da serveran joudavuz’.
email-recovery-busy: Oigendamine libo toine jonon tegend om radamas. Udišta da ladi udes vähä aigad jäl’ghe.
email-recovery-failed: Tegendad ei voind vahvištoitta. Udišta jono da ladi sama tegendad udes, ku tarbiž.
email-recovery-superseded: Kävutajan udemb tegend om vajehtanud necen küzundan. Nügüdläine jonon olod ozutadas.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Heitta-ik kaik jonos nügüd’ olijad kirjeižed necele saajale? Nende kontent heittas da sidä ei sa pördutada. Uded kirjeižed, miččed om tehtud necen küzundan jäl’ghe, kaitas.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Delivery could not be confirmed; review before retrying
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Delivery receipt could not be saved
sync-time-estimate-hint: Time estimates use the numeric original/remaining time fields created by Jira import. Exactly one matching field must exist on this board. Local edits are reviewed as conflicts; missing source values are ignored and explicit null clears the value.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint and releases are synced only while Scrum is enabled on this board. A sprint or release that is missing is created on this board, with the dates the source gives; an existing one is matched by its source ID first, then by name. A local planning change stays until the source changes that issue's planning, and a first Sync never removes planning.
activity-recovery-description: Unfinished notifications are retried automatically. Review missing or changed activities before retrying. Retrying never recreates an activity.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Could not load pending activity notifications.
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Plan and pending activity do not match
activity-recovery-busy: Another worker is handling this notification. Refresh and try again.
activity-recovery-denied: Recipient access or notification preferences no longer permit delivery.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: The original activity is missing or has changed. Nothing was recreated.
activity-recovery-failed: Could not complete notification delivery. Pending work has been retained.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: This notification changed since it was loaded. Review the refreshed state before trying again.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Could not confirm the delivery setting. Refresh and review its current state.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Permanently cancel remaining delivery for this activity? This cannot be resumed. Already queued email and delivered notifications are not recalled.
rule-email-recovery-description: Kacu kirjutetuid sändoiden email-kirjoiden oigendamižen yrityksid. Vahvištamatomad yritykset võivad völ oigenda vai ne oma katkestud. Nece tedotus ei oigenda tošti eikä lopeta oigendamišt.
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Yrityst selitavad tedod ei ole oiktad
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ei ole sändoiden email-kirjoiden oigendamižen yrityksid, kudambad sobiba necihe ecindaha.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Could not load rule email attempts. Refresh to try again.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ei oigenda vahvištamatomad email-kirjad iče tošti ni konz. Tošti oigenduz mäneb vai nišle sajile, kudambid ei ole vahvištud. Merki se oigendudaks, ku tedad, miše se om tulnu, vai heitä se.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ezmäine oigenduz voib völ jatkuda. Voit päta __time__ jäl'ghe.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Oigendada nece email-kirj tošti vahvištamatomile sajile? Kenan počtan server om otnu sen vastaha, no ei ole antnu tedoid WeKan-ale, se sab sen kahte kerda.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Merkita nece email-kirj kaikile oigendudaks? Tege nece vai siloi, ku tedad, miše se om tulnu.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Heitta nece email-kirj? Seda ei oigendeta vahvištamatomile sajile.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Ezmäine oigenduz voib völ jatkuda. Koita tošti jäl'gemb.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Necen email-kirjan azj om jo pättud.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Edeline tošti oigenduz voib völ jatkuda. Koita tošti jäl'gemb.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Kaik sajad oma jo vahvištud. Sen sijaha merki se oigendudaks.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Počtan server ei vastand. Tošti oigendud kirj voib olda tulnu vai ei; se ozutadas kut jatkui rad.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Toine haldai pätab necen email-kirjan azjan. Koita tošti penen aigan jäl'ghe.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Kaičetud email-kirj ei völ sopi necehe koitandaha, sikš sen azjad ei voi päta täs.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Necen koitandan kaičetud kirjutez om vär, sikš sen azjad ei voi päta täs.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Necen email-kirjan azjad ei voind päta. Udišta da koita tošti.
rule-email-legacy-description: WeKan-an edeline versii vaumišti nene sändoiden email-kirjad, no ei kirjutand, kuspäi niiden sizo tulob. Sikš WeKan ei oigenda neid iče. Kodvi, miše sändon tegijal om völ oikez tulda kartale, da sido kirj tošti, miše vaumištada se kartan nügüdižes tilas, vai heitä se.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Vaumištada nece email-kirj tošti kartan nügüdižes tilas? Sen sizo voib erota edeližes vaumištud sizos.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Heitta nece email-kirj? Seda ei oigendeta ni konz.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Kodvindad odotajid sändoiden email-kirjoid ei ole.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Kodvindad odotajid sändoiden email-kirjoid ei voind sada. Udišta, miše koita tošti.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Sändon tegijal ei ole enamb oiktust tulda necele kartale, vai sändo om toižetadud, sikš seda ei voi sidoda tošti. Voit heitta sen.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Toimind, kudamb augoti necen email-kirjan, om toižetadud, sikš seda ei voi sidoda tošti. Voit heitta sen.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kart, kuspäi nece email-kirj tuli, ei ole enamb sadabal, sikš seda ei voi sidoda tošti. Voit heitta sen.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Sändon täutmine, kudamb vaumišti necen email-kirjan, ei ole enamb kaičetud, sikš seda ei voi sidoda tošti. Voit heitta sen.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Nece email-kirj om jo oigendud, oigendust om koitud vai kirj om heittud.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Nece email-kirj om jo sidotud tošti.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Necid toimindad ei voind lopeta. Udišta da koita tošti.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
saml-login-not-started: Nece SAML-sizälekirjutand ei olend zavoditud täs brauzeran välilehtes. Ole hüvä, kirjuta sizäle uzin.
history-request-pending-undo: Server ei völ vahvištand sinun jäl'gmaišt tagaze-otandad.
history-request-pending-redo: Server ei völ vahvištand sinun jäl'gmaišt toižen kerdan tegentad.
history-request-hint: Toižen kerdan opitand oigendab saman pakičendan, sikš se ei voi nikonz otta tagaze toišt vajehtust.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: An undo, redo or restore of Scrum changes stopped on a conflict. Scrum edits on this board are blocked until it is resolved.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ of __total__ changes were written, __pending__ were not, and __conflicted__ were changed by someone else since.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Rolling back puts every changed record back as it was before; it is offered only when nobody else has changed those records since. Keeping the board as it is removes the stopped operation and changes no records. Either way, it is recorded in Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Keep the board as it is
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Keep every record as it is now, including the changes the stopped operation already wrote?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: A board administrator can roll it back or keep the board as it is.
login-setting-after-restart: Algab rata, konz WeKan kävutadas uzin
login-setting-env-only: Only the server environment sets these. They are shown here read-only.
